metadata.title: [BUG]: Admin UI hides public agents when a team is selected in the team switcher
metadata.author: a-effort

description:
### 🐞 Bug Summary
When a team is selected in the Admin UI team switcher, the A2A Agents tab (and other entity tabs) hide globally-public agents owned by other teams. Users expect "public" to mean visible regardless of team filter.

### 🧩 Affected Component
- [x] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel)
- [x] `mcpgateway` - API (semantic question for `?team_id=` filter)

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. As a platform admin, register an A2A agent with `visibility: public` under team A.
2. Sign in as a non-admin user who belongs only to team B.
3. In the Admin UI, select team B in the team switcher.
4. Navigate to the A2A Agents tab.

### 🤔 Expected Behavior
The public agent registered by the platform admin should appear, because `visibility = "public"` is intended to be globally visible.

### 🔍 Actual Behavior
The agent is not listed. The team switcher appends `&team_id={{ selected_team_id }}` to every entity list call (`mcpgateway/templates/admin.html:6801` and `:6854`), which causes `_apply_visibility_filter` (`mcpgateway/services/base_service.py:158-165`) to restrict the query to `team_id == X AND visibility IN ('team', 'public')`. Public rows owned by *other* teams are filtered out.

Direct API calls without `?team_id=` (e.g. `curl $CF_URL/a2a`) return public agents as expected — confirming this is a UI-induced narrowing rather than an API-layer bug.

### 💡 Suggested Approaches

Two reasonable directions, worth team discussion:

1. **UI fix (smaller blast radius)**: Stop auto-appending `team_id` to entity list requests when the team switcher is set. The selection could still be used for display/routing without changing the visibility query semantics.

2. **API semantic change (broader impact)**: Update `_apply_visibility_filter` so that even when `team_id` is supplied, `visibility = "public"` is always OR'd into the access conditions. This affects every entity type inheriting `BaseService` (tools, resources, prompts, gateways, servers, a2a) — would need explicit sign-off.


### 🧠 Environment Info
| Key | Value |
|-----|-------|
| Version or commit | `main` branch |
| Runtime | Python 3.11+ |
| Reproducible via | Admin UI + non-admin team-scoped user |
